# Audio Capture Checklist: System Audio Capture Pivot

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for system-audio capture,
microphone capture, dual-track truth, no-HAL boundaries, and artifact alignment.
**Created**: 2026-06-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design
artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are incoming/system-audio capture requirements complete for app, window, and display scope choices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK002 Are microphone capture requirements complete for permission state, selected input, frame counts, levels, start/stop timing, and failure reason? [Completeness, Data Model §MicrophoneCaptureSession]
- [x] CHK003 Are system-audio capture requirements complete for frame counts, silent/protected/blocked frames, dropped frames, scope approval, timing, and failure reason? [Completeness, Data Model §SystemAudioCaptureSession]
- [x] CHK004 Are dual-track writer requirements complete for normalizing both tracks to the existing MediaScribe-ready WAV contract? [Completeness, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK005 Are no-HAL requirements complete enough to exclude HAL publication, runtime probes, virtual-device selection, driver repair, and CoreAudio restart from MVP acceptance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the term "incoming/system audio" defined clearly enough to distinguish remote meeting audio from unrelated local media playback? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK007 Is `durationDifferenceSeconds <= 3` defined clearly enough to support track-alignment tasks and manifest validation? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK008 Are `silentInput`, `noFrames`, `protectedAudioBlocked`, and `emptyRequiredTrack` failure reasons distinct enough to avoid ambiguous degraded states? [Clarity, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK009 Is "sustained CPU" defined sufficiently for planning validation scripts, or does tasks generation need to add a precise sampling window? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are capture session entities consistent with manifest fields and validation evidence fields? [Consistency, Data Model §§SystemAudioCaptureSession/MicrophoneCaptureSession, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK011 Are the planned ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation responsibilities consistent with the feature's source-separation requirements? [Consistency, Research §Decisions, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK012 Are old shared-memory/driver incoming-audio assumptions explicitly superseded for MVP recording? [Consistency, Plan §Summary, Research §Alternatives Considered]
- [x] CHK013 Are artifact role names consistent across spec, manifest contract, existing MediaScribe-ready contract, and future backend expectations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for both tracks present, mic-only, incoming-only, no incoming audio, late-start, early-stop, and misaligned tracks? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for multiple displays/windows and supported app/browser capture scopes without implying arbitrary system-wide capture? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §CaptureScopeApproval]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for capture stop while one stream is still finalizing? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Capture Session]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for HAL driver installed, absent, ignored, and diagnostics-unavailable states? [Coverage, Spec §US5, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable for saved files, duration difference, permission blocking, no-HAL validation, and CPU gates? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Are development and release duration gates specific enough to generate evidence tasks without inventing new acceptance rules? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Quickstart §Duration Gates]
- [x] CHK020 Are blocked, failed, degraded, and not-tested outcomes explicitly excluded from accepted evidence? [Measurability, Contract §Validation Evidence]
